uncertainties: app/routers.py's APIRouter is never included by app/main.py, so GET /inventory/stock/{sku_cd} and GET /inventory/health are dead. This matters: order-service's InventoryClient POSTs to {base}/inventory/restore?ordNo=..&reason=.. — a path that exists in NEITHER the mounted app nor the unmounted router, and with a query-string contract rather than the JSON body /stock/restock expects. The order->inventory restock call appears to be broken or routed via something not in this repo. Flagged as uncertain, not asserted.

app/db.py connects to database 'sellflow_order' with user 'sellflow', contradicting README/registry ('MySQL (inventory)') and .env.sample (DB_URL=mysql://inventory:@localhost:3306/inventory). DB_URL in config.py is read but never used by db.py. The service in fact reads and writes on the shared order instance.
app/models.py dataclasses (Stock.sku_cd/qty, RestoreLog) do not match the live SQL (stock_item.sku/available_qty/reserved_qty). They are not used by any route.
